CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Despite successful target engagement and biological activity, the clinical endpoint failed. POPULATION EFFECTS: No subgroup analyses were reported. 5. CONFOUNDERS: This appears to be a diagnostic accuracy study comparing fluorescein to standard radioactive tracer. The failure seems to be that fluorescein, while biologically active, was not sufficiently accurate compared to the gold standard for clinical use.
